deterministic_ordering.column_order: identity -> timestamp -> provenance -> context -> QB -> team metrics -> targets
deterministic_ordering.row_order: season ASC, week ASC, game_id ASC

excluded_groups.identifiers: game_id, team names, venue_id, player_ids — metadata only
excluded_groups.is_home: home_is_home/away_is_home constant per side; excluded (redundant with team identity)
excluded_groups.market_data: no market columns in source; market tokens rejected at extraction
excluded_groups.offensive_total_epa: deterministic identity (passing_epa + rushing_epa); excluded to avoid duplication
excluded_groups.postgame_outcomes: home_score, away_score, target_margin — postgame, excluded from features
excluded_groups.postgame_qb_evidence_ids: postgame evidence IDs excluded from model matrix
excluded_groups.qb_imputed_flags: *_imputed flags for QB metrics — all True (constant), uninformative in base commit
excluded_groups.qb_observed_prior_constants: passing_epa_observed, passing_epa_prior, passing_epa_sample_size, prior_dropback_or_attempt_volume, prior_games — constant at priors in base commit, redundant with shrunk values + flags
excluded_groups.qb_status: qb_status is POSTGAME_ONLY_EVIDENCE for all rows — not forward-looking
excluded_groups.starter_certainty_text: starter_certainty, home_starter_certainty, away_starter_certainty — string-valued postgame evidence audit columns, not numeric features
excluded_groups.targets: target_home_win, target_margin, target_tie, target_available — preserved separately
